acceptance.provingCommand: legion gh -- api 'repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/README.md?ref=main' --jq .content | base64 -d | tail -n1 | grep -Fxq 'Stage 3 smoke check: Legion workflow proof.'
acceptance.surface: GitHub Contents API / merged README.md on the default branch (main) — the exact bytes a reader fetches.

concerns: README.md exists at repo root (current final line 'Legion smoke proof: stage 3.'), so append the new line at end of file; do not recreate it — the spec Errors 'create if missing' branch does not apply.
Acceptance 1 requires the new line to be the FINAL line of README.md; ensure a trailing newline on the prior last line so the appended text lands as its own last line.

Idempotency (spec Errors): if 'Stage 3 smoke check: Legion workflow proof.' is already the last line, make no change and report the file already satisfies acceptance rather than passing a no-op as a fresh edit.

Exactly one file changes and the change is additive text only: only README.md, exactly one added line, no existing line touched. Only .legion process artifacts may accompany the product diff and are removed at the end of a clean review.

implement: legion-worker: drives the implementer append -> commit -> 'jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" bookmark set legion/S391283701-1' -> 'jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" git push --bookmark legion/S391283701-1' -> 'legion gh -- pr create' with 'Dispatch: S391283701-1' in the body, and the READY-format E2E proof for the one-line README.md append 'Stage 3 smoke check: Legion workflow proof.' verified as the final line via the GitHub Contents API.
review: legion-worker: governs the reviewer's CI/threads/E2E verification against GitHub directly; the thermonuclear passes are skipped because this is a docs-only PR per the skill's Thermo rule, and approval requires both the implementer and tester E2E lines present.
test: legion-worker: defines the tester duty to verify the implementer's proof and add its own production-like proof; re-drive the GitHub Contents API for README.md at the PR head, confirm 'Stage 3 smoke check: Legion workflow proof.' is the exact final line and only README.md changed with exactly one added line, plus a negative control on a non-added line.
